title: 幫你影多張
mood: cocky, put-upon and grinning, a boyfriend playing the martyr for laughs
subject: a boyfriend stuck shooting two hundred photos of his girlfriend in front of a Sheung Wan mural, crouching, climbing a bollard, blocking tourists, until she picks the very first one
caption: Cantonese male-idol dance-pop in the 2025 Hong Kong boy-group choreography style. A punchy four-on-the-floor kick with a layered clap on two and four; sidechained supersaw stabs on the off-beat; a slap-style synth bass bouncing in octaves; a muted funk electric guitar chopping sixteenths; brass-synth hits marking every section change. Tight and loud mix, wide synths, dry upfront lead vocal, short plate reverb on the chorus. Male tenor, bright and clipped, half-rapping the verses with a cheeky swagger, belting the chorus, a group of male voices shouting the hook. 122 BPM, A minor. Cocky, put-upon and grinning. No trap hi-hat rolls, no autotune, no slow ballad breakdown, no EDM festival drop, no female lead.
lyrics:
[Verse]
上環嗰幅牆 你話光線啱啱好
我跪喺地下 膝頭哥貼住條渠
你話腳要長啲 要我再蹲低啲
旅行團行過 我仲要閃埋一邊

[Pre-Chorus]
你撥吓頭髮 又話唔夠自然
我講三二一 你又眨咗眼

[Chorus]
幫你影多張 再影多張
左邊少少 右邊又唔得
幫你影多張 再影多張
我部電話熱到 好似煲緊湯

[Verse]
第八十張 我爬上咗個石墩
保安望住我 我笑笑扮遊客
你話背景有個阿伯 行咗過去先
阿伯企定定 原來佢都喺度影相

[Pre-Chorus]
你話望住我 唔好望住鏡頭
我話望住你 我點對焦

[Chorus]
幫你影多張 再影多張
企高少少 跪低又唔得
幫你影多張 再影多張
二百張相 我對腳已經冇晒知覺

[Bridge]
你碌返上去 碌到最頂
你話第一張 第一張最靚

[Chorus]
幫你影多張 唔使影多張
第一張就得 早講就得
下個禮拜 又去邊度影
我帶定護膝 你記住唔好眨眼

[Outro]
三二一 喂 唔好眨眼
